Features that appeared, disappeared or changed status

Source: R/evolution.R
vp_state_moves.Rd

Features that appeared, disappeared or changed status between two versions.

Usage

vp_state_moves(old, new)

Arguments

old

The older version of a model (from vp_generate() or vp_read()).

new

The newer version of the same model.

Value

A tibble with feature, before and after, each "variable", "core", "dead" or "absent".

See also

Other evolution: vp_attachment(), vp_auc(), vp_changed_links(), vp_co_change(), vp_community_history(), vp_compare(), vp_disruptions(), vp_edit_type(), vp_eras(), vp_feature_churn(), vp_feature_states(), vp_flip_flops(), vp_forecast_size(), vp_growth(), vp_history_apply(), vp_history_changes(), vp_history_sizes(), vp_hub_stability(), vp_interaction_changes(), vp_life_cycle(), vp_link_lifetime(), vp_prediction_table(), vp_rename(), vp_rename_candidates(), vp_ripple(), vp_top_movers(), vp_version_distance()

Examples

old <- vp_generate(vp_example("miband3_planned.uvl"), or_graph = TRUE)
new <- vp_generate(vp_example("miband3_realized.uvl"), or_graph = TRUE)
vp_state_moves(old, new)
#> # A tibble: 0 × 3
#> # ℹ 3 variables: feature <chr>, before <chr>, after <chr>
